Reading · tablet or laptop?

1.1 Discuss. What do you write your homework on — a phone, a tablet, a laptop or paper? Why?

Muhokama qiling. Uy vazifangizni nimada yozasiz — telefonda, planshetda, noutbukda yoki qogʻozda? Nega?

KALIT SOʻZLAR

a keyboard klaviatura — harflar joylashgan qism

a screen ekran — qaraydigan qismingiz

a case gʻilof — biror narsani himoya qiladigan qoplama

second-hand yangi emas; oldin ishlatilgan

Tablet or laptop — what do you actually study on?

DILNOZA A tablet is lighter than a laptop and the battery lasts longer. I carry mine everywhere. Typing is slower, yes, but I write by hand with a pen on the screen, and for me that's better than typing anyway.

RUSTAM Slower? It's much slower. I wrote a 2,000-word essay on a tablet once and it took me two evenings. On a laptop it takes two hours. Tablets are nicer to read on, I agree — but a laptop is a more serious machine.

FARIDA For me the important thing is the price. Tablets are cheaper, and a second-hand one is cheaper still. My laptop was three times more expensive than my sister's tablet, and it is not three times better.

BEK Mine is heavier than a laptop! I bought a tablet, then a keyboard, then a case, then a pen. Now my bag is fuller than before and I've spent more money than I wanted to. Buy the laptop.

MAYA Nobody has mentioned the screen. A tablet screen is smaller, so you see less. When I have a text on one side and my notes on the other, bigger is simply better. In the library I use a laptop. On the bus I use the tablet.

SAM I think the honest answer is that the best machine is the one you have with you. My laptop is faster, stronger and more comfortable to type on. It is also at home, on the kitchen table, where it is right now.

2

Grammar · comparative adjectives

TUSHUNTIRISH — QIYOSIY SIFATLAR

Ikki narsa bir-biridan qanday farq qilishini aytish uchun qiyosiy sifatni ishlatamiz. Ikkinchi qismi — than.

A Qisqa sifatlar — -er qoʻshiladi. small → smaller · cheap → cheaper · hard → harder · Earbuds are smaller than headphones.

B -e bilan yoki bitta unli + bitta undosh bilan tugasa. nice → nicer · big → bigger · thin → thinner · hot → hotter

C -y bilan tugasa. easy → easier · heavy → heavier · noisy → noisier · happy → happier

D Uzun sifatlar (2+ boʻgʻin) — more ishlatiladi. expensive → more expensive · comfortable → more comfortable · interesting → more interesting

E Qoidasizlari — yodlab oling. good → better · bad → worse · far → further

Farqni kattalashtirish yoki kichraytirish: much / far / a lot + qiyosiy — much better, far more expensive. a bit / a little — a bit heavier.

DIQQAT — KOʻP UCHRAYDIGAN XATOLAR

Bu darajadagi deyarli har bir xato shu toʻrttasidan biri:

1 Imlo — ikkilangan harf. ✗ biger → ✓ bigger · ✗ cheapper → ✓ cheaper. Harf faqat bitta unli + bitta undoshdan keyin ikkilanadi: big, thin, hot, wet. cheap da ikkita unli bor, shuning uchun ikkilanmaydi.

2 Qisqa sifat bilan more. ✗ more hard → ✓ harder · ✗ more light → ✓ lighter

3 more va -er birga. ✗ more heavier → ✓ heavier · ✗ more smaller → ✓ smaller

4 very oʻrnida more. ✗ I haven't got headphones because they are more expensive. → ✓ … because they are very expensive. more ni faqat ikki narsani solishtirganda ishlating.

YORDAM SOʻRASH

Could you help me? · Can you help me? · Would you mind showing me? · Do you mind showing me?

mind dan keyin -ing ishlatish shart: Would you mind showing me? · Do you mind explaining it? Hech qachon Would you mind show me.

Javob berish. Could you…? ga → Yes, of course. / No problem. Do you mind…? ga → No, not at all. / No problem.

mind bilan ehtiyot boʻling. Do you mind…? — „siz uchun muammomi?“ degani. Shuning uchun No — „ha, yordam beraman“ degani. Doʻstona iltimosga Yes desangiz, rad etgandek eshitiladi.

5.8 Read the model conversation, then answer.

Namunaviy suhbatni oʻqing, keyin javob bering.

MODEL

NIGORA Dad, you look worried.

FATHER I can't send this photo to your uncle. Could you help me?

NIGORA Of course. First, open the photo — that one, yes. Then click on the little arrow at the bottom.

FATHER Sorry, which arrow? So first I touch this one, on the left?

NIGORA No, the one under the photo. That's right. Now choose your uncle's name.

FATHER Like this? And then I press the blue button. Is that right?

NIGORA Exactly. Look — two grey ticks. He's got it.

FATHER Thank you. Now show me one more time, slowly. I want to remember it, not just do it.

Namuna haqidagi savollarga javob bering.

2 Find three instruction words Nigora uses to order the steps.

3 Which line shows that the father is not only trying to finish the task?

5.10 Work in pairs. Student A asks for help; Student B explains. Then change.

Juftlikda ishlang. A oʻquvchi yordam soʻraydi, B oʻquvchi tushuntiradi. Keyin almashing. Buni sinfda bajarasiz.

Student A — you have a problem

Student B — you know how to do it

You bought a new phone but you can't receive text messages.

Explain, step by step. Wait after each step.

You can't get into your email on a new tablet.

Explain, step by step. Say That's right when A is correct.

SUHBATINGIZNI TEKSHIRING

Could you…? yoki Would/Do you mind …ing? bilan yordam soʻradim.
Sherigim toʻgʻri javob berdi (mind bilan ehtiyot boʻling).

Koʻrsatmalarni uch marta tekshirdim — So first…? · Like this? · Is that right?
First / Then / After that ni ishlatdim.

Asosiy feʼlga urgʻu berdim va har bir savol oxirida ovozim pasaydi.
